answer: Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, which means holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in prism and relic lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the opal graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1518 impostors cost 1645 times the honest price and take 4 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
